note.en: Representative local Kohn–Sham equations. Published examples cover spin-unpolarized exchange-only Dirac LDA for spherical helium and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation for fixed periodic He/He₂ cells. The radial atomic implementation and periodic PySCF workflows are separate series with different bases, boundaries and references. Inspect each input and validation record below; these examples do not validate GGA, hybrids, general materials or excited states.

note.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

assumptions.ja: 固定した非対称2原子Heセル（5 bohr立方、4価電子、非偏極・整数占有、局所GTH、LDA_X＋VWN5）。PySCFライブラリを使う検証ドライバー。物理的な平衡He物質や長時間MDではありません。
assumptions.en: Fixed asymmetric two-He cell (5-bohr cubic lattice, four valence electrons, unpolarized integer occupations, local GTH and LDA_X plus VWN5). A library-backed PySCF validation driver; not physical equilibrium helium or long-time MD.

limits.ja: 不正モデル・非有限値・参照の改変・SCF未収束・力/収束公差不達を拒否。未収束の力をBOMDへ渡さない。短い刻み比較は長時間NVEを保証しない。
limits.en: Reject invalid models, nonfinite values, altered references, SCF nonconvergence and missed force/refinement criteria. Do not pass unconverged forces to BOMD. A short step comparison does not establish long-time NVE conservation.

reference_note.ja: 独立DFTK平面波計算：Γ／2³の解析力、8カットオフ設定、全6座標のエネルギー有限差分。共通Libxcと異なる有限基底の制約を明記。
reference_note.en: Independent DFTK plane waves: Gamma/2³ analytic forces, eight cutoff settings and all-six-coordinate energy finite differences. State shared Libxc formulas and different finite-basis limits.
